sealing_rule: No Extended Experiment temperature target, plot, aggregate, or residual may be opened before the implementation and this protocol are committed. Acquisition metadata and archive paths may be amended without viewing target values; numerical thresholds, periods, forcing mappings, and model parameters may not.

forbidden_after_unsealing: fabric or topology changes based on target residuals
sensor selection based on favorable error
model_policy.implementation_commit: must be the commit that adds this protocol and the published-component boundary implementation

fixed_preprocessing.source_row_semantics: row T is the interval mean forcing over (T-10min, T] and the measured state at T; canonical timestamp is T-10min
fixed_preprocessing.initial_state: seed every published N2 air body from the immediately preceding measured record
fixed_preprocessing.weather: use the official Extended Experiment N2-aligned weather channels without interpolation
fixed_preprocessing.cellar_boundary: arithmetic mean of the two registered N2 cellar air-temperature channels
fixed_preprocessing.heater: measured electrical heater power with the published 0.70 convective and 0.30 radiative split
fixed_preprocessing.internal_gains: measured room internal-gain power aggregated by the published four-air-body map
fixed_preprocessing.mechanical_ventilation: measured supply volume flow and supply temperature
fixed_preprocessing.openings: measured Child-1 window position and kitchen/living door position through per-opening canonical controls
fixed_preprocessing.shading: published phase schedule; west kitchen blind closed, other declared blinds open unless the official schedule explicitly states otherwise
fixed_preprocessing.missing_values: reject the scored interval; do not interpolate target temperatures or actuator states
fixed_preprocessing.time_zone: Europe/Berlin local civil time with explicit UTC offset

secondary_extended_diagnostics.purpose: phase-stratified diagnostic only; cannot rescue a failed primary score

required_reporting: pooled and per-air-body bias, MAE, RMSE, maximum absolute error, and correlation
error by experimental phase and day/night period
all missing or rejected source rows
source archive SHA-256 and byte size
one immutable pass/fail decision using the predeclared criteria
amendment_rule: After target acquisition, corrections are allowed only for independently demonstrable software defects. Every correction requires a new protocol version and the original blind result remains published; the corrected run is labeled post-unsealing, never retroactively blind.
